Definition: future active participle masculine of G2390; about to cure; Jason, a Christian:--Jason.
BiblicalUsage: Jason opened his house to Paul in Thessalonica and paid for it. In Acts 17:5 the Jews who believed not set the city in an uproar and assaulted the house of Jason, in Acts 17:6 they dragged him before the rulers crying that these men have turned the world upside down, and in Romans 16:21 Paul greets him as a kinsman and fellow worker.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jason is the picture of what hospitality costs: he took Paul in, and the mob came to his door. Paul still counted him among his own.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Paul at Thessalonica
